name: sdrift-sqlglot-sqlglot-001-shared
instr:
# Correct behaviour that contradicts sqlglot's documentation

QA on `sqlglot` (a dependency-free SQL parser, transpiler, optimizer, and expression toolkit) surfaced outputs that don't line up with the documentation (source docstrings, README.md, posts/ast_primer.md, and posts/onboarding.md).
Depending on the input, the drift can produce incorrect values or unexpected errors. Locate the mismatches and
fix the implementation so its behaviour follows the documentation.

Work only in `/app/sqlglot/`; do not change the API, signatures (except default values that must be restored to match the checked-in documentation), or layout, and do not add files. No
internet. Follow the documented public behaviour throughout the library.

Before editing, write a short plan to /app/notes.md — what the docs specify, where the code diverges, and how you'll verify your fix — then implement it.
